actions.name: create_note
actions.description: Save a note in the Notes tab. Use for ideas, meeting notes, summaries, anything to remember.

content.description: Note body. Light markdown allowed (bullets with •, or -).

ref.description: Optional id like 'n1' so tasks/spending in the same reply can link to this note

actions.name: create_todo
actions.description: Add a task to the To-Do tab. Resolve relative dates ('tomorrow 9am', 'next Friday') into absolute ISO 8601 timestamps WITH the user's UTC offset. If the user asks to be reminded, set remindAt. For repeating tasks or bills (rent, internet, subscriptions) set rrule; if it costs money set bill so paying it logs spending.

dueAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime with offset, or null

remindAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime with offset, or null

status.description: doing = the user is working on it right now (the board's Doing column). Default todo.

rrule.description: Repeat rule for recurring tasks/bills, RFC 5545 subset: 'FREQ=DAILY|WEEKLY|MONTHLY|YEARLY;INTERVAL=n'. e.g. monthly rent -> 'FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL=1'. null if not recurring.

bill.description: For bills: the amount logged to Finance when the task is completed

category.description: One of the user's categories, except Income.

noteRef.description: ref of a note created in this same reply, to link the task to it

actions.name: start_todo
actions.description: Move an existing open task to the Doing column because the user says they are working on it now. Match by a distinctive part of its title.

actions.name: complete_todo
actions.description: Mark an existing open task as done. Match by a distinctive part of its title.

actions.name: add_transaction
actions.description: Record money spent (positive amount) or received (negative amount, category Income) in the Finance tab. Also use for pasted e-wallet or bank notifications (GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay, QRIS, BCA, Mandiri…).

amount.description: Number only, no thousand separators. Positive = spending.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, default to the user's currency

category.description: One of the user's categories (listed in <user_data> as categories). Use 'Other' when none fit.

splitWith.description: Names of people splitting this bill equally with the user

actions.name: split_transaction
actions.description: Split an existing expense equally with other people, e.g. 'split the Warteg bill with Andi and Budi'.

includeMe.description: Whether the user also pays a share (default true)

actions.name: set_budget
actions.description: Set a monthly budget for a spending category, in the user's base currency.

category.description: One of the user's categories, except Income.

actions.name: create_sticky
actions.description: Save a very short jotting (max ~15 words) as a quick note on the Today page.

capture.name: file_capture
capture.description: Classify the captured content and extract structured data so the app can file it in the right tab.

kind.description: receipt = store receipt / invoice / payment proof / e-wallet or bank app screenshot (GoPay, OVO, DANA, QRIS, m-banking). handwritten_note = handwriting or typed notes. todo_list = a checklist of tasks. other = anything else.

reply.description: One friendly sentence telling the user where it was filed.

note.description: For handwritten_note, other, or recordings: transcribed/summarized note.

receipt.description: For receipts only. Always fill this for a receipt, including total.

total.description: Grand total actually paid, number only. Negative if money was received.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; use today if not visible

category.description: One of the user's categories (listed in <user_data> as categories). Use 'Other' when none fit.

todos.description: Tasks / action items found (checklists, or action items in a recording). Never put receipt line items here; they go in receipt.items.

rrule.description: Repeat rule for recurring tasks/bills, RFC 5545 subset: 'FREQ=DAILY|WEEKLY|MONTHLY|YEARLY;INTERVAL=n'. e.g. monthly rent -> 'FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL=1'. null if not recurring.
